title: The saturation gate never fired on either
result: `sysctl` prints the load in the user's locale — "19,70", not "19.70" — and `awk -v` only treats a value as numeric when it looks numeric, so the comparison was done on strings: `"19,70" > "8"` is false because `"1" < "8"`. The mini, at load 136 on 8 CPUs with 0.0% idle, was reported healthy. Fixed by normalising the separator and forcing numeric context.
evidence: `tests/runner/preflight-load-gate.sh` pins the discriminating case; the mini now reports `load=136.31 cpus=8 cpu_idle=0.0` and degrades.
